title: werauhia tiquirensis
intro: Werauhia tiquirensis, commonly known as the "Tiqui Plant" or "Queñua de los Andes", is a type of flowering plant in the bromeliad family. It has been traditionally used in Andean folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Werauhia tiquirensis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and promote digestive health, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Werauhia tiquirensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
